remarks: Price Update! Welcome to 133 Main Street Unit 5! Located in the middle of Norwalk's burgeoning West Wall Street area. This renovated condo offers charm and ease of living and a great canvas to personalize your living space. The primary bedroom comfortably accommodates a queen-size bed, while the second bedroom can function as a second bedroom or home office. Custom closets throughout the home provide excellent storage and help maximize space. The large attic is a great additional storage space. Conveniently located near great restaurants, parks, and entertainment, this property will serve as a great space for those needing to be within proximity to New York or the hubs of surrounding cities. There is easy access to the Metro North - it is a short 5-minute walk away with connections to other transit and the main highways. The walkability factor makes this an opportunity to get around on foot, placing you steps. This Condo, with its very low HOA charge of $230, is an ideal choice for those seeking a vibrant, low-maintenance lifestyle in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after areas.
